stemBlocks: A student set up an experiment to measure the rate of photosynthesis, as shown in the diagram.

Data was collected and plotted on a graph.
If plotted, which of the following variables would give a gradient that is directly proportional to the rate of photosynthesis?
(All other variables were kept constant.)

|  | x-axis | y-axis |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | time | volume of CO$_2$ released |
| 2 | time | number of gas bubbles released per minute |
| 3 | volume of oxygen released | time |
